# Forge

> A from-scratch B-Rep geometry kernel in Rust, built for correctness, determinism, and AI-assisted development.

## Project Overview

- [Development Blueprint](DEVELOPMENT_BLUEPRINT.MD): Full engineering specification — 10 phases, 58 milestones, 9 global doctrines.
- [Product Pitch](PRODUCT_PITCH.md): Vision and market positioning.

## Documentation

- [Forge Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Crate dependency graph and doctrine summary.
- [Exactness Contract](docs/exactness-contract.md): Precision guarantee model (planar = exact, curved = certified bounds).
- [Tolerance Policy](docs/tolerance-policy.md): ModelingContext tolerance infrastructure.
- [File Naming Dictionary](docs/FILE_NAMING.md): Deterministic naming conventions for source files.

## Agent Rules (always-on)

- [Conventions](/.agent/rules/CONVENTIONS.md): Canonical source of truth — all rules in one place.
- [Architecture Rules](/.agent/rules/architecture.md): Mandatory crate boundaries and dependency direction.
- [Crate Map](/.agent/rules/CRATE_MAP.md): Cross-crate ownership and import lookup reference.

## Agent Workflows

- [Add Feature](/.agent/workflows/add-feature.md): Workflow for adding a new feature or milestone.
- [New Module](/.agent/workflows/new-module.md): Create a new module following the Bento Box pattern.

## Crate Map

- `forge-math`: Exact arithmetic, predicates, filtered evaluation (no internal deps).
- `forge-topo`: Halfedge mesh, Euler operators, topology state (depends on forge-math).
- `forge-geom`: Analytic surfaces, NURBS, curves (depends on forge-math, forge-topo).
- `forge-kernel`: Features, booleans, fillets (depends on all above).
- `forge-io`: STEP, IGES, STL, JSON serialization (depends on all above).
- `forge-test`: Differential harness, fuzzer generators, KV suites (test-only).
